firm_data.firm_description: Quatela Chimeri PLLC is a boutique law firm well-recognized as a premier business litigation and family law practice serving Long Island and the Greater New York Area. The firm consists of seasoned attorneys who specialize in various practice areas, providing strategic advocacy to protect clients' interests and financial longevity.
notable_facts: The firm is one of the few premier appellate advocacy firms on Long Island.
They offer a focused and holistic approach to legal specialties.
The firm has served Long Island residents for more than 25 years.

email.subject: AI for Quatela Chimeri PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

Qatela Chimeri is one of the few premier appellate advocacy firms on Long Island, and that focus on complex litigation across multiple practice areas is exactly where AI can amplify your team's impact.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on appellate and commercial litigation work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
